import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 210;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static int[][] cap = new int[MAXN*MAXN*2+10][MAXN*MAXN*2+10];
    static int[][] flow = new int[MAXN*MAXN*2+10][MAXN*MAXN*2+10];
    static int[] h = new int[MAXN*MAXN*2+10];
    static int[] cnt = new int[MAXN*MAXN*2+10];
    static int N, T, S, Tgt;

    static int get_id(int i, int j) {
        return (i-1)*N + j;
    }

    static boolean in_range(int x, int y) {
        return x>=1 && x<=N && y>=1 && y<=N;
    }

    static void add_cap(int u, int v, int c) {
        cap[u][v] += c;
    }

    static int augment(int u, int limit) {
        if (u == Tgt) return limit;
        int pushed = limit, delta, min_dist = N*N*2+2;
        for (int v = 0; v < N*N*2+2; ++v) {
            if (cap[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0) {
                if (h[u] == h[v] + 1) {
                    delta = augment(v, Math.min(pushed, cap[u][v] - flow[u][v]));
                    flow[u][v] += delta;
                    flow[v][u] -= delta;
                    pushed -= delta;
                    if (h[S] == N*N*2+2 || pushed == 0) return limit - pushed;
                }
                min_dist = Math.min(min_dist, h[v] + 1);
            }
        }
        if (pushed == limit) {
            cnt[h[u]]--;
            cnt[min_dist]++;
            if (cnt[h[u]] == 0) h[S] = N*N*2+2;
            h[u] = min_dist;
        }
        return limit - pushed;
    }

    static int dinic() {
        if (S == Tgt) return INF;
        for (int i = 0; i < cap.length; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(flow[i], 0);
        }
        Arrays.fill(h, 0);
        Arrays.fill(cnt, 0);
        int result = 0;
        while (h[S] < N*N*2+2) {
            result += augment(S, INF);
        }
        return result;
    }

    static class State {
        int x, y, steps;
        State(int x, int y, int steps) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.steps = steps;
        }
    }

    static int[][] dist_from_start = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static boolean[][] visited_bfs = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] board1 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] board2 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int start_x, start_y;
    static final int[] dr = {0,0,-1,1};
    static final int[] dc = {-1,1,0,0};

    static void bfs_start() {
        Queue<State> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new State(start_x, start_y, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist_from_start[i], 0x7f7f7f7f);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(visited_bfs[i], false);
        }
        visited_bfs[start_x][start_y] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            State cur = q.poll();
            dist_from_start[cur.x][cur.y] = cur.steps;
            if (cur.steps > T) break;
            for (int k=0; k<4; ++k) {
                int nx = cur.x + dr[k], ny = cur.y + dc[k];
                if (in_range(nx,ny) && board1[nx][ny] != 'Y' && !visited_bfs[nx][ny]) {
                    State nxt = new State(nx, ny, cur.steps+1);
                    visited_bfs[nx][ny] = true;
                    q.offer(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs_from_cell(int i, int j) {
        Queue<State> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new State(i, j, 0));
        for (int k = 0; k < MAXN; k++) {
            Arrays.fill(visited_bfs[k], false);
        }
        visited_bfs[i][j] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            State cur = q.poll();
            if (cur.steps > T) break;
            if (dist_from_start[cur.x][cur.y] < cur.steps) continue;
            if (dist_from_start[cur.x][cur.y] == cur.steps && (board2[cur.x][cur.y] < '1' || board2[cur.x][cur.y] > '9')) continue;
            if (board2[cur.x][cur.y] >= '1' && board2[cur.x][cur.y] <= '9') {
                if (cur.x != i || cur.y != j) {
                    add_cap(get_id(i,j), get_id(cur.x,cur.y) + N*N, INF);
                }
                if (dist_from_start[cur.x][cur.y] == cur.steps) continue;
            }
            for (int k=0; k<4; ++k) {
                int nx = cur.x + dr[k], ny = cur.y + dc[k];
                if (in_range(nx,ny) && board1[nx][ny] != 'Y' && !visited_bfs[nx][ny]) {
                    State nxt = new State(nx, ny, cur.steps+1);
                    visited_bfs[nx][ny] = true;
                    q.offer(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            board1[i] = new char[MAXN];
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                board1[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            board2[i] = new char[MAXN];
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                board2[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
            }
        }
        
        S = 0;
        Tgt = 2*N*N+1;
        for (int i=1; i<=N; ++i) {
            for (int j=1; j<=N; ++j) {
                if (board1[i][j]>='1' && board1[i][j]<='9') {
                    add_cap(S, get_id(i,j), board1[i][j]-'0');
                }
                if (board1[i][j]=='Z') {
                    start_x = i; start_y = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i=1; i<=N; ++i) {
            for (int j=1; j<=N; ++j) {
                add_cap(get_id(i,j), get_id(i,j)+N*N, INF);
                if (board2[i][j]>='1' && board2[i][j]<='9') {
                    add_cap(get_id(i,j)+N*N, Tgt, board2[i][j]-'0');
                }
            }
        }
        bfs_start();
        for (int i=1; i<=N; ++i) {
            for (int j=1; j<=N; ++j) {
                if (board1[i][j]>='1' && board1[i][j]<='9') {
                    bfs_from_cell(i,j);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dinic());
    }
}
